method: Actual Play Mode with native A/D and Up keyboard input; bounded in-memory observers; no test files or suite.

capture.note: Uses actual capture intervals. Capture overhead lowers sampling to about 12 Hz; not a native-FPS or zero-sliding benchmark.

known_limits: Support-foot trajectories are not uniformly spaced; slight sliding may remain.
Effective silhouette heights vary by up to 33px (~2.1%); up poses need clearer weight rise.
Legacy Idle/Jump differ slightly in line and clothing details from new Walk.
Current 4.2 speed / 2.05 stride produces 2.05 full cycles per second; cadence is brisk.
other_observations: Jump at the right boundary landed on its low collider top; jump-native.csv records that separate edge case. Flat-street jump-street.csv is the completed normal-ground jump check.
Earlier jump-input.csv and jump-complete-input.csv did not capture received jump input; jump-wall-input.csv captured only a jump landing tail. They are not used as complete jump proof.
Native Input System state sampled from Editor callbacks may differ in update phase; transition checks use actual position and pose.
